approvals.name: edit_image

style.prompt: Create a photorealistic billboard mockup for a landscape LinkedIn post. Image 1 is the exact poster artwork to display; image 2 is the bridge location photograph to use as the environment. Expand the bridge photo naturally into a landscape 16:9 composition, preserving the Golden Gate Bridge's recognizable structure, perspective, water, hills and daylight. Add a plausible freestanding roadside billboard beside the bridge in the foreground, positioned to one side so the main bridge tower remains visible. The billboard display must be portrait-oriented to fit the entire supplied poster without stretching or cropping it. Faithfully reproduce the original poster artwork, colors, border and all original lettering; do not rewrite, redesign or add words. Make the poster large and clearly visible. Integrate billboard frame and supports with realistic perspective, daylight, shadows and scale. No other added advertising, captions or logos.
